gaps.explanation: detail[] revenue lines 0-7 come from the p8 'Supplementary Budgetary Comparison Schedule for All Funds Combined - Modified Cash Basis'. It is an all-funds (governmental + utility) schedule on a cash-receipts basis, and its 'Claims, Refunds, Reimbursements, and Other Local Receipts' 98,393 (detail 7) holds the utility fund's cash receipts as well as the governmental other receipts. The governmental funds statement p4 prints Total Revenues 140,107. Arithmetic: p4 governmental other receipts (Interest 3,878 + Dividend 758 + Electrical Distribution System Lease 32,698 + Charges For Services 1,340 + Claims, Reimbursements, and Refunds 279 + Licenses and Permits 3,213) = 42,166. 98,393 - 42,166 = 56,227 = utility cash receipts (p7 cash flow: Receipts from Customers 53,138 + Customer Utility Deposits 150 + Interest 2,939). p8 also prints Sales Tax 22,011 where p4 prints 22,625 (-614). So 195,720 - 140,107 = 56,227 - 614 = 55,613. The schedule prints no split of the 98,393 line by fund, so no exact detail fix is possible. Both totals are as printed: p8 Total Revenues and Transfers 195,720; p4 Total Revenues 140,107.

The utility (proprietary) fund prints Total Revenues 53,464 + Net Nonoperating Revenues 2,939 = 56,403 on p6. It has no separate schedule. Its receipts are inside the p8 all-funds combined budget schedule line 'Claims, Refunds, Reimbursements, and Other Local Receipts' 98,393 (detail 7, tagged governmental), on a cash basis: 56,227 = p7 Receipts from Customers 53,138 + Customer Utility Deposits 150 + Interest 2,939. The 176 difference from 56,403 is the accrual/cash difference (p7 change in sales tax and payroll liabilities). Adding p6 lines would count the same money twice, because it is already in detail 7. No fix.

Detail 8 'Utility' 64,976 (p8 all-funds budget schedule) is cash paid: p7 Payments to Suppliers 56,205 + Payments to Employees 8,771 = 64,976. The p6 proprietary statement prints Total Expenses 65,657, which includes Depreciation 591 and accrued salaries (Salaries 8,861 vs cash 8,771 = 90). 64,976 + 591 + 90 = 65,657; gap 681 = 591 + 90. Both printed totals are correct on their own basis.
